feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 10 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 this evening, veering west overnight, then decreasing west or southwest 3 or 4 early tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in places at first, falling slight overnight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle in the east imminently clearing to become mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, increasing southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, further increasing 5 to 7 overnight, veering west or southwest 3 or 4 Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate occasionally rough overnight, then slight or moderate Saturday afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle spreading from the west overnight into Saturday, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
